title: Instance-optimal high-precision shadow tomography with few-copy measurements: A metrological approach
abstract: arXiv:2602.04952v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the sample complexity of shadow tomography in the high-precision regime under realistic measurement constraints. Given an unknown $d$-dimensional quantum state $\rho$ and a known set of observables $\{O_i\}_{i=1}^m$, the goal is to estimate expectation values $\{\mathrm{tr}(O_i\rho)\}_{i=1}^m$ to accuracy $\epsilon$ in $L_p$-norm, using possibly adaptive measurements that act on $O(\mathrm{polylog}(d))$ number of copies of $\rho$ at a time. We focus on the regime where $\epsilon$ is below an instance-dependent threshold.   Our main contribution is an instance-optimal characterization of the sample complexity as $\tilde{\Theta}(\Gamma_p/\epsilon^2)$, where $\Gamma_p$ is a function of $\{O_i\}_{i=1}^m$ defined via an optimization formula involving the inverse Fisher information matrix. translated_title: 具有少量副本测量的实例最优高精度影子断层扫描：一种计量学方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在现实测量约束下高精度区域内影子断层扫描的样本复杂度。给定一个未知的 $d$ 维量子态 $\rho$ 和一组已知的可观测量 $\{O_i\}_{i=1}^m$，目标是使用可能自适应的测量方法，在 $L_p$ 范数下以精度 $\epsilon$ 估计期望值 $\{\mathrm{tr}(O_i\rho)\}_{i=1}^m$，其中每次测量作用于 $O(\mathrm{polylog}(d))$ 个 $\rho$ 副本。我们关注 $\epsilon$ 低于一个依赖于具体实例的阈值的区域。我们的主要贡献是将样本复杂度刻画为 $\tilde{\Theta}(\Gamma_p/\epsilon^2)$ 的实例最优形式，其中 $\Gamma_p$ 是通过涉及逆 Fisher 信息矩阵的优化公式定义的关于 $\{O_i\}_{i=1}^m$ 的函数。此前，紧致界仅在特殊情况下已知，例如具有 $L_\infty$ 范数误差的 Pauli 影子断层扫描。
tldr: 本文给出了高精度影子断层扫描样本复杂度的实例最优刻画 $\tilde{\Theta}(\Gamma_p/\epsilon^2)$，其中 $\Gamma_p$ 由涉及逆 Fisher 信息矩阵的优化公式定义。
en_tdlr: This paper provides an instance-optimal characterization of the sample complexity of high-precision shadow tomography as $\tilde{\Theta}(\Gamma_p/\epsilon^2)$, where $\Gamma_p$ is defined via an optimization formula involving the inverse Fisher information matrix.
